decision_conditions: All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission, being 9th October 2024.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

The development shall be implemented and carried out in strict accordance with the tree protection measures, Arboricultural Method Statement And Tree Survey details which were formally approved by the Local Planning Authority under the application for the discharge of condition: CLC2025/00048.Reason: To ensure the protection of trees which are important to the appearance and character of the area, as required by Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved must be constructed and retained thereafter in accordance with the recommendations as outlined in the submitted acoustic report (reference: 30213141-ARC-XX-XX-RP-AE-S3-0002 dated March 2024).Reason: To protect neighbour amenity in accordance with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Detection and Alarm Layout; Fire Strategy Plans; and Fire Evacuation PolicyReason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
